commits: fix: route workflow help through plugin command

requirements.desc: `senti workflow --help` must dispatch to the workflow plugin command and print command-level help containing `Usage: senti workflow <subcommand> [args]`.
requirements.note: R1: workflow --help prints command-level workflow usage

requirements.desc: `senti workflow --help` output must contain the workflow subcommands `add`, `update`, `show`, `search`, `list`, `publish`, and `ideas`.
requirements.note: R2: workflow --help lists current workflow command subcommands

requirements.desc: `senti workflow --help` must not render package-level output headed by `Plugin: workflow` as its primary output.
requirements.note: R3: workflow --help does not render plugin package help as the primary output

requirements.desc: `senti help workflow` must continue to render package-level workflow plugin help headed by `Plugin: workflow` and include the workflow command row.
requirements.note: R4: help workflow keeps package-level workflow plugin help

requirements.desc: Core and independent command shared help paths must retain existing behavior for `senti help`, `senti plugin --help`, and `senti plugin find --help`.
requirements.note: R5: existing core and independent help routes keep shared metadata behavior

requirements.desc: `senti workflow` without a help flag must continue to reach plugin command dispatch and return the workflow command's normal no-subcommand result.
requirements.note: R6: workflow without a help flag still dispatches to the workflow command

requirements.desc: A nonexistent plugin command help request must not exit successfully with rendered help output.
requirements.note: R7: unknown plugin command help requests do not become successful help output

requirements.desc: Spec-local coverage should exercise both contributed plugin command help and package-level plugin help through the CLI entry point.
requirements.note: R8: spec-local coverage declares every testable requirement in the header
